install: pnpm install && pnpm --filter api deploy --prod <dir> (pnpm-workspace.yaml: injectWorkspacePackages: true)
oracle: `pnpm list --prod --depth Infinity --json` run inside the deploy directory, names and versions read from each listed path's own package.json; workspace packages left out (see the hand fix).
notes: pnpm 12 deploy needs injectWorkspacePackages: true (or --legacy, which still exists; not used here). The layout is the deploy directory only, with the pnpm-workspace.yaml pnpm wrote there. Surprise for §5: deploy rewrites the workspace dependency in the deployed package.json to "@acme/shared": "@acme/shared@file:///w/packages/shared" (an absolute container path, /w, in a specifier that does not start with `file:`) and copies @acme/shared into node_modules/.pnpm/@acme+shared@file++++w+packages+shared/, a real path inside node_modules. A walk that only checks for a `file:` prefix and for a real path outside node_modules reports @acme/shared@1.0.0; the expected list leaves it out. Hand fix: `pnpm list` reports the injected workspace package @acme/shared (version "file:///w/packages/shared"; its package.json says 1.0.0). It is a workspace package, so it is removed from the expected list. Installed on Linux aarch64 in Docker.
